Maya Chen: Putting up a small PR to fold embed-shard examples and migration notes into model cards. PR #4601 :memo:
Samir Gupta: Which models?
Maya Chen: Nebula3b (embed sharding), ZephyrX (bench anchors), Polaris13b (safe limits), Aurora-lite3b (KV cache notes).
Lin Zhao: For Nebula3b add a deterministic shard-key example and a note about deduping when reassembling embeddings.
Maya Chen: Example snippet added in PR: `shard_key = hashlib.sha1(id.encode()).hexdigest()` and link to merge guidance.
Devex: Use `from redwood.client import Client` in snippets and add the snippet-smoke CI job to the checklist.
Maya Chen: Updated imports and checklist.
Samir Gupta: Also include a short table under Polaris13b: advertised limit | recommended safe limit | common pitfalls.
Maya Chen: Will do.
Docs Bot: PR #4601 opened by Maya Chen  reviewers: @Lin Zhao, @Samir Gupta, @Devex.
Lin Zhao: I'll add a tiny unit test exercising chunked embed calls.
Maya Chen: Thanks, aiming to merge after tests. I'll also add stable anchors for ZephyrX bench links to prevent rot.
Docs Bot: PR #4601 merged  changes deployed to staging docs.
Maya Chen: Quick smoke on staging looks good. Closing thread.
